context: T-6 repo-chain ADR mirror for the shipped blueprints/edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting/contributions/adrs/adr-3702-edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting-layering.json contribution. The security-auth-magic-link blueprint ships a per-email per-minute application-level rate limiter on the mint surface; edge-cloudflare-rate-limiting ships a zone-level IP-per-URL rate rule at the CF edge. Without an explicit layering ADR the operator can mistake the two rules for overlapping.
decision: When both blueprints apply, the zone rule sits at the CF edge and refuses the (N+1)th request for the elicited duration before it reaches the origin; the magic-link per-email rate limiter continues at the mint-surface. The two rules operate on different characteristic sets (IP-per-URL vs per-email per-minute) and are additive. recommendedDefault: true. Standards trace clause: generic enterprise practice.
consequences: The composition is documented in the guide with a copy-paste example. The applied recorder records both blueprints so the operator sees the two-rule shape at apply time; drift into overlap is caught in the drift-audit runner.
title: Layering with security-auth-magic-link: zone rule OVER the per-email application rule
